# Repo layout

Where things live. Edit `config/layout.json`, then `python tools/layout.py build`.

<!-- generated by tools/layout.py below this line - edit config/layout.json -->
## Root folders

| Folder | What lives there |
| --- | --- |
| `.agents/` | shared agent rules and skills |
| `.claude/` | Claude Code project settings and agents |
| `.git/` | git |
| `.local/` | this PC's local installs (git-ignored) |
| `.staging/` | working copies (git-ignored), one folder per task |
| `.unsnooze/` | update-check state |
| `.vscode/` | editor settings |
| `_out/` | what tools and tests write on this PC (git-ignored) |
| `apps/` | apps the hub serves: voice, faces, gacha, camera, photobooth, tv |
| `config/` | settings and registries (JSON), one file per subject |
| `dist/` | the built MiceHub.exe and its shortcuts |
| `docs/` | plan, architecture, system headers, references |
| `firmware/` | ESP32 firmware for every module (PlatformIO) |
| `handoff/` | one task file per open task (handoff/tasks/) |
| `llm/` | the voice helper's local model data |
| `main_python/` | the hub (MiceHub): server, device routes, web pages |
| `nong/` | Nong Studio (nong/main_python_set_nong): moves, sequences, simulator UI |
| `qc/` | the QC suite (qc/run_qc.py, qc/checks/) |
| `scient_test/` | measured experiments (results + scripts) |
| `shared/` | web parts every page uses (shared/web/mice-ui.js) |
| `tools/` | developer tools: plan, handoff, build, bench, layout |

## Root files

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.gitignore` | what git never keeps |
| `.qc-receipt.json` | this PC's last green QC (git-ignored) |
| `AGENTS.md` | Codex/GPT's rules |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Claude's short rules (read on every turn) |
| `GEMINI.md` | Gemini's rules |
| `HANDOFF.md` | first file any AI reads: rules, where things are, how to hand off |
| `MiceHub.spec` | the ONE way to build MiceHub.exe |
| `PATCHES.md` | index of the numbered code patches (tools/save_code_patch.py) |
| `README.md` | what this project is, how to start |
| `promote.py` | staging -> real tree, only when QC is green |
| `promt.md` | the user's prompt log, written by the .claude hook |
| `requirements.txt` | Python packages |

## Working copies

`.staging/<task>` (default `.staging/main`): `python promote.py --staging <task>`.

## Tool output (git-ignored)

- `_out/ai_watch/`: the AI usage-limit watcher's state, events and worker logs (tools/ai_watch.py)
- `_out/runs/`: results of long experiments (RL, benchmarks) a tool saves
- `_out/scratch/`: experiments and samples (was scratch/)
- `_out/test_media/`: photos and videos for face/video tests (was _photo_test/, _video_test/)

Inside a folder, `python tools/systems.py which <file>` names the
system and its header in `docs/systems/`.
